decisions.reason: Clause (iv) indexed potentials only for i<j but used u_ij for every ordered force. For N=2, the declared u_12 supplied no defined u_21 for F_21. Repaired by defining F_ij=-grad_{x_i}u_ij and F_ji=-grad_{x_j}u_ij for each i<j, with reversed force arguments explicitly displayed. Differentiating the finite sum now gives the entire force decomposition, without assuming antisymmetry of arbitrary pair potentials.

The original e_j were declared in the spatial displacement space K but used for the coordinate datum, field and curve passed to the R^3-valued uniform-force and Newtonian-flow interfaces. The repair declares e_j as standard coordinate triples and distinguishes the frame basis b_j in K through gamma(t)=o+tu+sum_j x_j(t)b_j. All computations now have their required types, and the spatial and coordinate planar interpretations agree.
